$comment: A tour that goes across apps: Launchpad home -> Manage Sales Orders -> SAP GUI (VA01). Steps with "app" are shown in that app; the tour pauses in between and goes on after a page reload too.

steps.title: From the Launchpad to SAP GUI
steps.text: This tour takes you through two apps. It goes on by itself when the next app opens.

steps.title: Check existing orders
steps.text: Before you create an order, search here to see whether the customer already has one.

steps.title: Create the order in SAP GUI
steps.text: Orders are created with transaction VA01. Press Next to open it.

steps.title: Start the transaction
steps.text: Type the transaction code and press Enter.

steps.title: Order type
steps.text: Enter the order type for a standard order.
